page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture. The server delivers 8 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock frequency of 3.2 GHz. Paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The hardware profile does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, necessitating reliance on network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps, and the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Because the resource allocation emphasizes dedicated processing cores over memory capacity, this instance offers a cost-efficient deployment profile for CPU-bound tasks without overhead from unutilized RAM or local disk enclosures. Appropriate workloads for the ecs.c9i.2xlarge include web application serving, batch compute processing, CI/CD runners, and distributed application microservices requiring stable compute throughput.
